subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The class did not reach one answer, but they asked better questions.”?
options: The Warm Wall shows that even quiet people may have something helpful to say.
Instead, because someone filled the silence with kindness, it became part of the show.
People enter more easily when the door connects to something they already care about.
It became something with a voice, even if humans had to speak for it.
